match_rule: |obs - ref| < tol (strict), one match per peak
null_design: one common shift s for the whole reference list; |s|~U(2,20) nm, sign +/-1 equiprobable
archive_null_design: per draw, the same shift s is applied to the reference list for every spectrum; statistic = sum of per-spectrum matched-peak counts. Axis test uses the first axis_null_draws of the archive draws
